_meta.crash_source: CHP California Crash Reporting System (CCRS), data.ca.gov: Crashes and InjuredWitnessPassengers 2023-2025, County Code 7
_meta.peers: 50 most similar block groups by standardized income, homes per acre, home value, year built, share without a car, single-family share, from LA County plus this county (all CHP CCRS 2023-2025)
_meta.metric: 3-year count of crashes involving a pedestrian or cyclist, inside the block group or within 10 m of its boundary
_meta.thresholds: gap if worse than at least 80% of peers and at least 10% from the peer median; strength if at most 20%
_meta.rows: crash-dependent rows re-run through pipeline/engine.py with the rebuilt counts
